subject: First-mile renewal playbook & QBR availability
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@brightloop.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightloop.io
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: First-mile renewal playbook & QBR availability

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we discussed, BrightLoop's annual renewal window is coming up and we'd like to kick off a focused runbook to surface: term options, capacity uplift opportunities, pricing levers, and a QBR to align execs and the engineering stakeholders.

To keep this lightweight, proposed next steps:
- Redwood to share a 1-page mutual action plan (attached) with milestones for procurement/legal/ops.
- BrightLoop to share current monthly token/embedding volume and any projected peak events for next 12 months.
- Schedule a 60-min QBR (exec + engineering) in the next 2 weeks to review options.

Can you confirm who from your side should be on the QBR (we've CC'd procurement but happy to add product/infra leads)? And please send 2–3 windows that work for you next week.

I've attached a draft agenda and the mutual action plan for the runbook. Ben will own the QBR facilitation and Karthik will bring capacity/throughput recommendations.

Thanks — look forward to your availability.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: BrightLoop_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx, QBR-Agenda-Draft.pdf
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@brightloop.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightloop.io, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: First-mile renewal playbook & QBR availability

Thanks Ava — this looks good.

Attendees: Myself (Head of ML), Priya Desai (VP Product), Mark Turner (SRE), and RFP/Contracts (procurement@brightloop.io). If we need an exec, I can invite our CTO (Elena Park) for the QBR readout.

Availability next week:
- Tue 17 Jun, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 18 Jun, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 19 Jun, 09:00–10:00 PT (tight for Mark but possible)

I'll pull and attach a short usage snapshot for May (token and embedding counts) and send it by end of day. Can you also indicate if you plan to present a recommended capacity/price uplift in that QBR or keep it as options?

—Sam
Sam Lee
Head of ML | BrightLoop
sam.lee@brightloop.io

Hey team —

Thanks Sam, those windows work. I'm going to lock Tue 17 Jun, 10:00–11:00 PT as a provisional slot and send a calendar invite with a short agenda (60 min). If Elena wants to join we can keep the first 15 min as exec readout and the remainder focused on capacity and terms.

Quick note on the QBR content: we'll prepare
- Current usage & headroom (short slide)
- 2–3 term/price scenarios (annual commit, stepped staircase, and burst add-on)
- Capacity runbook suggestions (autoscale thresholds, cache policy)

Ava — can you confirm the primary success metric BrightLoop cares about for this renewal (likely cost per 1M tokens or p95 tail latency)? We'll tailor the proposal to that.

Ben Carter
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: (will include invite + agenda)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@brightloop.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Quick capacity ask ahead of QBR

Sam —

Appreciate you sending the May snapshot. To make the runbook actionable, could you include these in the usage attachment:
- Peak hourly token rate for the month (per region if available)
- Typical request sequence length distribution (p50/p90/p99)
- Percentage of requests using caching or embeddings vs completion generation

If you prefer I can share a one-page forecast template — it helps us simulate cost/latency under the different commit models.

Also, if BrightLoop expects any major events in H2 (product launches, marketing spikes), flag them now so we can size headroom properly.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 15:04:00 -0700

All — attaching the May snapshot (BrightLoop_usage_snapshot_May2025.csv). Quick answers inline:
- Peak hourly token rate (global): ~2.1M tokens/hr, peak on 5/14 during campaign launch.
- Sequence length (median/90/99): 64 / 240 / 1,120 tokens.
- Mix: ~58% completions, 35% embeddings, 7% reranking/other.

We do have a planned product beta in late Sep that could increase peak hourly demand by ~30–50% for a 2–3 week window.

Slot confirmation: Tue 17 Jun, 10:00–11:00 PT works for our group. Please send the invite. Looking forward to a proposal — we'd like to see 1 recommended path and 2 alternates in the QBR.

Thanks — Sam

Attachments: BrightLoop_usage_snapshot_May2025.csv
